Container.Name: MediaReducer
Container.Overview: Deletes the movies and TV seasons you are least likely to miss when storage runs low. Reads Plex/Tautulli, Jellyfin or both, scores every movie and season on watch history and IMDb rating, and removes the lowest first. [br][br] [b]Early alpha, and it deletes files with no recycle bin.[/b] It starts paused. Use Simulate until the output is exactly what you would have deleted yourself, and keep backups. [br][br] No login, so keep it on your LAN and use a VPN from outside. [br][br] Needs Tautulli (for Plex) or Jellyfin, plus internet for the IMDb ratings. Radarr and Sonarr are optional, to stop a deleted movie or TV season being re-downloaded.

Config.Name: WebUI Port
Config.Description: Host port for the web interface. The container always serves on 7474.

Config.Name: Movie library
Config.Description: The folder CONTAINING your movie folders: films in /mnt/user/media/Movies means /mnt/user/media here, then add Movies as a monitored path in the UI. Must be writable, and it is the only place MediaReducer can delete from.

Config.Name: Config storage
Config.Description: Settings, logs, cache, IMDb data and your deletion history. Keep it on the array so it survives a container rebuild.

Config.Name: Tautulli appdata (optional)
Config.Description: Read-only, and only so Auto Detect can read the Tautulli API key and Plex token. Skip it and enter them yourself.

Config.Name: Radarr appdata (optional)
Config.Description: Read-only, and only so Auto Detect can read the Radarr API key. Skip it and enter the key yourself.

Config.Name: Sonarr appdata (optional)
Config.Description: Read-only, and only so Auto Detect can read the Sonarr API key. Skip it and enter the key yourself.

Config.Name: PUID
Config.Description: Run as this user instead of root. 99 is nobody on Unraid. It needs write access to your movies and /config, since deletions use its permissions. Blank runs as root.

Config.Name: PGID
Config.Description: Group for the above. 100 is users on Unraid.

Config.Name: MEDIAREDUCER_TRUSTED_HOSTS
Config.Description: Leave empty unless you already reverse-proxy this. It adds no login: it only lets a proxy domain reach the UI, and anyone who can is free to delete your media. Comma-separated, e.g. media.example.com.
